methods.explanation: The basic properties of algebraic fractions only allow multiplying (or dividing) both the numerator and denominator by the same nonzero polynomial expression; adding the same expression is not allowed. Since \(m\) may be 0, C is incorrect. Since \(y-x=-(x-y)\), we have \((x-y)/(y-x)=-1\).
